name: Amphenol Industrial Operations
old_description: High-reliability power/signal connectors, cable assemblies, and junction boxes
about:
Amphenol Industrial Operations is headquartered in Endicott, New York. The division operates as part of Amphenol Corporation, a global interconnect manufacturer. No founding year or founder names are disclosed in public materials.

The company produces circular power and signal connectors, cable assemblies, junction boxes, and value‑added box builds. Its portfolio includes proprietary RADSOK® contact technology for high‑amperage applications, ruggedized circular and rectangular interconnects, and board‑level contacts such as the GT, AC, PT, Amphe‑Lite, PowerBlok, SurLok Plus, ePower, UPC, H4 Plus, and UPT series. Over 2,500 employees work across eight manufacturing sites in North America, Asia‑Pacific, Europe, and the Middle East, supporting custom‑engineered cable assemblies and overmolded harnesses.

Customers span alternative energy (including solar), heavy equipment, energy storage, factory automation, eMobility, rail mass transit, datacom/telecom, data‑center power, and power distribution. The company supplies OEMs requiring harsh‑environment interconnects for diesel‑engine vehicles, battery and fuel‑cell systems, locomotives, and high‑density server power.

Amphenol Industrial emphasizes its global manufacturing footprint, regional technical and sales support, and design capabilities for harsh‑environment reliability as key differentiators.
